_comment: English changelog — keep entries in sync with changelog.json

entries.title: Gallery guides now include images and videos
entries.body: Gallery entries can now show example images and YouTube or Vimeo videos right inside the write-up, so you can see how a prompt works while you read. Copy buttons on code and prompt blocks are included, and images are compressed automatically so pages open fast.

entries.title: A gallery of work prompts, skills, and workflows
entries.body: Browse ready-to-use prompts, skills, and step-by-step workflow guides by job function — planning, marketing, sales, dev, HR, finance, and more — at prompts.dumply.app/gallery. Search to find what you need, download skills as files, and tap “Save to my library” to keep what you like. Each entry has a write-up with how-to and tips, and the top bar takes you straight back to your library.

entries.title: Share a prompt by link, save it with just your email
entries.body: You can now share a single prompt as a link. Anyone who opens it can sign in with the link we email them and the prompt lands in their own library — no sign-up steps. Share pages appear in Korean, English, and Japanese, and you can stop sharing at any time.

entries.title: Dumps are now read with the 5W1H principle
entries.body: When organizing a brain dump, Alfredo now also extracts who, when, where, what, how, and why. Events get their people and location filled in automatically, and you can check the 👥 📍 🔧 💡 chips in the inbox rationale line and the detail view. Works without an AI key too, powered by built-in rules.

entries.title: Prompt Library beta is live
entries.body: The Prompt Library — save your go-to prompts and pull them out instantly — is now in beta at prompts.dumply.app. Automatic platform sorting, tags and search, and cross-device sync are free, and connecting a personal Anthropic API key unlocks unlimited AI prompt improvement and generation.

entries.title: Fixed calendar monthly view not loading
entries.body: Fixed an issue where monthly events wouldn't load. Also improved Google sign-in stability for non-store installs.

entries.title: Smoother onboarding
entries.body: Lightened up onboarding so first-time users can finish their first dump within 30 seconds.

entries.title: First release, with Alfredo
entries.body: The first release of the side-panel extension where Alfredo the detective penguin reads your dumps and sorts them with MoSCoW. Supports Claude · OpenAI · Gemini (BYOK).
